Token validator permits ASCII alphanumeric, hyphen and underscore only; period is rejected.

Documented proxy options and fixed bearer authentication; no managed subscription login interface.
requires_openai_auth controls use of native OpenAI API-key or ChatGPT login authentication.
Native ChatGPT authentication chooses ChatGPT Codex backend by default.
Native auth constructor supports in-memory externally managed ChatGPT tokens with account identity.

limitations: Public source read as data, not executed.

reproduction_command:
rtk proxy .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
record=json.loads(Path('docs/qualification/phase-2d-subscription-route-source-evidence-v1-20261009.json').read_text())
ref=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.github.com/repos/openai/codex/git/ref/tags/'+record['upstream_tag'],timeout=20))['object']
observed=[dict(ref)]
while ref['type']=='tag':
    ref=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(ref['url'],timeout=20))['object']
    observed.append(dict(ref))
assert observed==record['tag_resolution']
assert ref['type']=='commit' and ref['sha']==record['upstream_commit']
for item in record['files']:
    data=urllib.request.urlopen(item['url'],timeout=20).read()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
    assert len(data)==item['bytes']
    assert len(data.decode('utf-8').splitlines())==item['line_count']
print('tag resolution and five public whole-source identities match; no fetched code executed')
PY
